responsibility: Declares the Intrinsics helper that compiles Rust intrinsic ABI function types into GCC trees. This small interface isolates intrinsic-body generation from ordinary item and extern lowering, exposing a single entry point parameterized by the current compile context and resolved TyTy function signature.
same_name_distinction: Declares the minimal Intrinsics helper interface—a context-bound class with a single compile entry point for intrinsic ABI functions. Unlike the .cc counterpart, it does not define any intrinsic-name dispatch tables, handlers, or synthetic body generation.
